title: Check scanner.Err() after scan loop in readEnvFile
definitionOfDone: scanner.Err() is checked after scan loop
IO errors are either logged or returned to caller

implementationPlan.description:
Add `scanner.Err()` check after the scan loop (line 157) in `readEnvFile`. Since the function returns `string` (not `(string, error)`), and changing the signature would break callers, log the error:
```go
if err := scanner.Err(); err != nil {
    slog.Warn("readEnvFile: scan error", "path", path, "error", err)
}
return ""
```
This preserves the existing contract while ensuring IO errors are visible.
Run `go test ./cmd/cordumctl/...` to verify no regressions.
